latest_release.name: Prisma 6, Native TS, Skills, and more!
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* More route reorganization by @kenn in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1053
* remove tsconfig aliases by @kentcdodds in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1054
* Set inputmode="text" by default to otpInput field by @Tony-Truand in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1056
* Add varlock example by @theoephraim in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1063
* Update Prisma command to specific version 6 by @aerojeyenth in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1064
* chore: change prisma generate command to use npm exec by @CodingAleCR in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1065
* Migrate server code to `server/index.ts` and simplify processes by @kasperpeulen in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1066
* Fix express middleware and dev script loading mocks by @kasperpeulen in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1076
* Add comprehensive guides for various Epic Stack skills by @rubenpenap in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1078

## New Contributors
* @Tony-Truand made their first contribution in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1056
* @theoephraim made their first contribution in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1063
* @aerojeyenth made their first contribution in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1064
* @rubenpenap made their first contribution in https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/pull/1078

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/epicweb-dev/epic-stack/compare/2025-10-16...2026-01-20
